findings.title: TOCTOU between membership check and native Raise call
findings.message: Raise checks registry membership under the mutex in publishFocus, then releases the lock before calling SystemWindow.Raise(). A concurrent close can retire the window in that gap, so native Raise runs on an already-closed window. The new tests only cover reentrant close on the same goroutine, not a cross-thread close. The patch comments say snapshots do not extend native lifetimes, which leaves this window open. Focus restoration in closed() takes a candidate from unregister() and calls Raise on it, so the same gap exists there.
findings.suggestion: Make the native Raise tolerate a window retired after publishFocus (for example, a closed flag checked on the native side), or document and enforce that Raise and close run on the same owner thread. Add a concurrent Raise/close test.
